ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Source_Record_Id__c)), OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Source_Type__c, "Call"), LEFT(Source_Record_Id__c, 3) <> "00T"), AND(ISPICKVAL(Source_Type__c, "Email"), LEFT(Source_Record_Id__c, 3) <> "02s"), AND(ISPICKVAL(Source_Type__c, "Online Meeting"), LEFT(Source_Record_Id__c, 3) <> "00U"), AND(ISPICKVAL(Source_Type__c, "Offline Meeting"), LEFT(Source_Record_Id__c, 3) <> "00U") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Source Record Id의 앞 3자리가 Source Type과 일치하지 않습니다. Call은 Task(00T), Email은 EmailMessage(02s), Online/Offline Meeting은 Event(00U) ID여야 합니다.
